race.comment: FIORONA (10) has the right profile to take another step third-up after winning her Mdn at this track by three and a half lengths, then finishing second as favourite in a Class 1 at Morphettville when beaten just under a length. She has already beaten THINK LU BELLA through that latest line and comes back from Saturday company into an easier meeting, which makes her the one to beat. THINK LU BELLA (11) was fourth in the same Class 1 race as FIORONA first-up, with some early interference and a 1.5kg claim now in play, so she can improve second-up. OUI OUI MA CHERIE (7) was beaten a nose at Murray Bridge last start after racing wide throughout, and third-up fitness gives her a genuine chance to hold that form. GRUELLING (6) finished third last time over 1511m at Morphettville, beaten 0.6 lengths. Jason Holder gets the best out of this six-year-old gelding. Finds a more suitable contest and can give this a shake.
